Rashi on Nedarim 38a:11:1.english: If without payment - What is his greatness [in that]?

Rashi on Nedarim 38a:11:2.hebrew: לאפוקי ממאן דשקל בלא אגרא - כל מי שהוא רוצה חמורו של חבירו בלא שכר, ומאי מעליותא היא דלא הוה גזלן? כ"ע נמי לא גוזלין נינהו:
Rashi on Nedarim 38a:11:2.english: To exclude from one who takes without payment - [That refers to] anyone who wants his fellow's donkey without payment; and what merit is it that he was not a robber? Everyone else is not robbers either!

Rashi on Nedarim 38a:12:1.hebrew: דלמא - האי דלא שקיל אפי' באגרא לאו משום עושר, דלמא משום דעני הוה ולא הוו ליה משואות, ולהכי לא הוה צריך:
Rashi on Nedarim 38a:12:1.english: Perhaps - That he did not take [an animal] even for hire was not because of wealth; perhaps [it was] because he was poor and had no loads [to transport], and therefore he had no need [for one].

Rashi on Nedarim 38a:12:2.hebrew: אלא מהכא - שמעינן דעשיר היה, מפסל לך:
Rashi on Nedarim 38a:12:2.english: Rather, from here - we learn that he [Moses] was wealthy, from [the verse] "Hew for you."

Rashi on Nedarim 38a:12:3.hebrew: ביתו עמו - כלי תשמישו, וזה היה מרוב עושר:
Rashi on Nedarim 38a:12:3.english: His house [was] with him - His household utensils, and this was due to [his] great wealth.

Rashi on Nedarim 38a:13:1.hebrew: לא חמור אחד מהם נשאתי - בעל כרחו אפי' בשכר, הא ברצון בעלים היה שוכר. ואילו גבי שמואל וכו' — לא עשקתנו ולא רצותנו, שלא היה שוכר לא באונס ולא ברצון:
Rashi on Nedarim 38a:13:1.english: I have not taken one donkey from them - Against his will, even for payment; [meaning that] with the owner's consent he would rent [it]. Whereas with regard to Samuel, etc., "You have not defrauded us, nor oppressed us [ratzotanu]" — that he would not rent [anything], neither by coercion nor with consent.

Rashi on Nedarim 38a:17:1.english: And he may feed his wife and his children - of the one bound by the vow.

Rashi on Nedarim 38a:17:2.hebrew: אע"פ - שהמודר חייב במזונותן, כיון דלאו לפטומי עבידן ודי להן במאי שהוא מפרנסן, לאו הנאה מרובה עביד ליה:
Rashi on Nedarim 38a:17:2.english: Although - [the one] bound by the vow is obligated in their sustenance, since they are not meant to be fattened and what he provides for them suffices for them, he is not conferring a great benefit upon him.

Rashi on Nedarim 38a:17:3.hebrew: ולא יזון את בהמתו בו' - הואיל ולפטומי עבידן, עביד ליה הנאה מרובה:
Rashi on Nedarim 38a:17:3.english: And he may not feed his animal, etc. - Since [animals] are meant for fattening, he provides him with a great benefit.

Rashi on Nedarim 38a:17:4.hebrew: נפשה לשמים וגופה שלו - לאכילה, משום הכי לא יזון אותה לפטומי, שמהנהו הנאה מרובה:
Rashi on Nedarim 38a:17:4.english: Its soul [belongs] to Heaven and its body is his - for eating. Therefore, he may not feed it to fatten [it], for he benefits him with a great benefit.

Rashi on Nedarim 38a:1:1.english: This [is] the commandment - It is written in Jeremiah.

Rashi on Nedarim 38a:1:2.hebrew: ידרוך דהדורך - כתיב, וקראי לא גרס להו ידרוך, דכתבן ולא קריין:
Rashi on Nedarim 38a:1:2.english: “Bend” that is in “the archer” - It is written [in the text], and the readers do not recite “bend” [yidroch], as [these are words that] are written but not read.

Rashi on Nedarim 38a:1:3.english: Of “that a near kinsman you [are]” - In Ruth.

Rashi on Nedarim 38a:1:4.english: “Five” of “the south side” - And [the Gemara] does not explain their reason.

Rashi on Nedarim 38a:5:1.english: To teach you - Thus, the Holy One, blessed be He, commanded [Moses] to give it to Israel.

Rashi on Nedarim 38a:6:1.english: Write for yourselves - Thus [it is evident] that [the Torah] was also given to them, to Israel.

Rashi on Nedarim 38a:6:2.hebrew: למען תהיה לי לעד - שילמדו כל התורה וילמדו אותה, אלמא לישראל נמי ניתנה:
Rashi on Nedarim 38a:6:2.english: That it may be a witness for Me - [This means] that they should learn the entire Torah and teach it; thus, it was given to Israel as well.

Rashi on Nedarim 38a:6:3.hebrew: פלפולא בעלמא - להבין דבר מתוך דבר הוא דניתן למשה, ונוהג בה טובת עין ונתנה לישראל:
Rashi on Nedarim 38a:6:3.english: Merely profound analysis - [It was] to understand one thing from another that was given to Moses, and he acted generously with it and gave it to Israel.

Rashi on Nedarim 38a:7:1.english: He spread it - This implies that he was mighty and [had] a large body.

Rashi on Nedarim 38a:7:2.english: And say that he was tall and thin - [Meaning] that he was not bulky and was not strong.

Rashi on Nedarim 38a:8:1.english: And their thickness [was] three [handbreadths] - And even so, he broke them.

Rashi on Nedarim 38a:9:1.hebrew: ותחסרהו מעט - וזו היא אחת, שאותה אחת היה הקב"ה יתירה עליו:
Rashi on Nedarim 38a:9:1.english: And You have made him lack a little - And this is [the] one [measure], for [by] that one [measure] the Holy One, blessed be He, was greater than him.

Tosafot on Nedarim 38a:11:1.hebrew: אי בלא אגרא - מי הוא דשקיל בלא אגרא, ומאי רבותא? אלא אפילו באגרא לא שקיל, דעשיר היה:
Tosafot on Nedarim 38a:11:1.english: If without payment - Who is it that takes without payment, and what is the novelty? Rather, even with payment he did not take [a donkey], for he was wealthy:

Tosafot on Nedarim 38a:11:2.english: Perhaps because he was poor - And he did not want to hire [one] from them.

Tosafot on Nedarim 38a:12:1.hebrew: ביתו עמו - כלי תשמישו עמו, ואינו נהנה משל אחרים:
Tosafot on Nedarim 38a:12:1.english: His home was with him - [Meaning,] his utensils [for personal use] were with him, and he did not benefit from [the property] of others:

Tosafot on Nedarim 38a:13:1.hebrew: דאילו במשה כתיב: "לא חמור אחד מהם נשאתי" - בעל כרחייהו; מכלל דברצון שכרה, ושמא לא היו רוצים ובושים לסרב מלהשכיר. ואילו בשמואל כתיב "רצותי" — משמע: לא בקשתי לשכור ממנו ואפילו בריצוי:
Tosafot on Nedarim 38a:13:1.english: Whereas with regard to Moses it is written: "I have not taken one donkey from them" - [That is,] against their will; which implies that with [their] consent he did rent it, and perhaps they did not [actually] want [to], yet were embarrassed to refuse to rent [it out]. Whereas with regard to Samuel it is written "ratzoti" [referring to ratzotanu, "nor have you appeased/pressured us"] — which implies: I did not [even] ask to rent from him, even with persuasion.

Tosafot on Nedarim 38a:17:1.hebrew: וזן את אשתו ובניו - אי אתיא כחנן ניחא, דמבריח ארי בעלמא הוא. וכי אתיא נמי כרבנן ניחא שפיר, דמיירי הכא ממזונות יתירות ואין נפרע [מבעלה]; דכי פליגי רבנן, היינו במפרנס סתם: אע"פ שלא פי' לשם הלואה, מ"מ לשם מתנה לא יהיב, והוי לרבנן כמו יורד לתוך שדה חבירו שלה ברשות, דנוטל מה שהשביח. וחנן מחלק בין השביח להיכא דלא הוה אלא מבריח ארי מנכסי חבירו. א"כ, אם נותן מתנה לאשה, דין הוא שאין יכול לתבוע לבעל כלום; והכא מיירי שנותן מתנה לאשה ממכירי הבעל:
Tosafot on Nedarim 38a:17:1.english: "And he may feed his wife and children" - If [this Mishnah] follows Chanan, it is straightforward, for he is merely chasing away a lion. And even if it follows the Rabbis, it also works well, for here it is speaking of extra sustenance and he does not collect [from her husband]; for when the Rabbis disagree, that is when he supports [her] without specifying: even though he did not specify [that it is] as a loan, nevertheless he did not give [it] as a gift, and according to the Rabbis he is like one who enters his fellow's field without permission, who takes what he improved. Whereas Chanan distinguishes between [where] he improved [it] and where he was merely chasing a lion away from his fellow's property. Therefore, if he gives a gift to the woman, it is right that he cannot claim anything from the husband; and here it is speaking of where one of the husband's acquaintances gives a gift to the woman.

Tosafot on Nedarim 38a:17:2.hebrew: לא יזון את בהמתו בין טמאה בין טהורה - משום דלפטומא עבידא, והוי הנאה גמורה, שנהנה זו מגופה וזו מפירה:
Tosafot on Nedarim 38a:17:2.english: He may not feed his animal, whether non-kosher or kosher - Because it is meant for fattening, and it is a complete benefit, as he benefits from one [the kosher animal] through its body, and from the other [the non-kosher animal] through its yield:

Tosafot on Nedarim 38a:17:3.hebrew: אמר להם כו' - שהטמאה נפשה וגופה לשמים, שאינה יכולה ליהנות אלא בעוד נפשה בה, הלכך לאו הנאה היא. אבל טהורה — נפשה לשמים, כלומר: אע"פ שנפשה לשמים, גופה שלו לשחיטה:
Tosafot on Nedarim 38a:17:3.english: He said to them, etc. - For the non-kosher [animal], its soul and its body belong to Heaven, as it cannot be benefited from except while its soul is within it; therefore, it is not [considered a] benefit. Whereas [for] a kosher [animal], "its soul belongs to Heaven" — that is to say, even though its soul belongs to Heaven, its body is his for slaughter.

Tosafot on Nedarim 38a:1:1.hebrew: זאת דהמצוה - פרשה ואתחנן, ואינו כך בשום חומש:
Tosafot on Nedarim 38a:1:1.english: "Zot" of "hamitzvah" ["This" of "the mitzva"] - [This is in] Parashat Va'etchanan, and it is not like this in any Chumash.

Tosafot on Nedarim 38a:1:3.hebrew: צדקתך כהררי אל - ולא קרי כהררי אל צדקתך; וי"א: הוי"ו מוצדקתך, שאמר אנחנו וצדקתך:
Tosafot on Nedarim 38a:1:3.english: "Your righteousness is like the mountains of God" - And it does not read "like the mountains of God is Your righteousness"; and some say [that the scribes' ornamentation refers to] the [omitted] vav from "and Your righteousness" [u-tzidkatekha], as it said "we and Your righteousness":

Tosafot on Nedarim 38a:5:1.hebrew: [אותי צוה] - הכי אמר משה לישראל: "אותי צוה, ואני לכם":
Tosafot on Nedarim 38a:5:1.english: [Me He commanded] - Thus Moses said to Israel: "[He] commanded me, and I [teach it] to you."

Tosafot on Nedarim 38a:6:1.hebrew: למען תהיה השירה הזאת לעד בבני ישראל - ואי בשירה לחוד, מאי עדות איכא:
Tosafot on Nedarim 38a:6:1.english: "That this song may be a witness among the children of Israel" - And if [it refers] to the song alone, what testimony is there?

Tosafot on Nedarim 38a:6:2.hebrew: אלא פלפולא בעלמא - שיטת חריפות והבינה נמסר למשה רבינו, ונהג טובת עין, ואמר משה כו':
Tosafot on Nedarim 38a:6:2.english: Rather, [it was] merely profound analysis - The method of sharpness and understanding was handed over to Moses our teacher, and he acted generously, and Moses said, etc.:

Tosafot on Nedarim 38a:7:1.hebrew: [וכתיב עשר אמות אורך הקרש] - אלמא ארוך היה, וכיון דהיה ארוך — גבור היה:
Tosafot on Nedarim 38a:7:1.english: [And it is written: "Ten cubits shall be the length of a board"] - Evidently, he was tall, and since he was tall, he was mighty.

Tosafot on Nedarim 38a:8:1.hebrew: עביין ג' - והוצרך לחבטן בקרקע בכח גדול:
Tosafot on Nedarim 38a:8:1.english: Their thickness was three [handbreadths] - and he had to strike them against the ground with great force.
